::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_intents"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated. `status` and `purpose` narrow in SQL and are VALIDATED — an unrecognised value is a 400 naming the vocabulary, never an empty page. Every row carries `attempt_count` (the “Payment Attempts” column). No other query parameter is accepted.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | no | Only intents with this status. |
| `purpose` | `string` | no | Only intents with this purpose. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of intents to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `payment_intent`. One of `payment_intent`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The payment intent's id (pi_…). |
| `data.status` | `string` | `voided` is set by the void route alongside `voided_at`. One of `inited`, `in_progress`, `authorized`, `consumed`, `expired`, `voided`. |
| `data.purpose` | `string` | Whether the intent takes a payment or saves a payment method. One of `payment`, `setup`. |
| `data.amount_minor` | `integer` | Always 0 for a `setup` intent. |
| `data.max_amount_minor` | `integer` | The mandate ceiling this `setup` intent registered with, and what a retry re-registers with. Null for `payment` intents. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The payment intent's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.attempt_count` | `integer` | Payment attempts — how many times this intent has been tried at the gateway. |
| `data.last_attempt_status` | `string` | Status of the NEWEST attempt. `status` above cannot express a refusal — there is no `failed` intent status, because a declined authorization leaves the intent OPEN so it can be retried — so this is what distinguishes a declined intent from one the buyer is still working through. `null` means no attempt has been made yet. One of `inited`, `requires_action`, `authorized`, `consumed`, `failed`, `voided`. |
| `data.next_action` | `object` | How the buyer completes the challenge, when one is outstanding. |
| `data.expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the intent expires (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.voided_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the intent was voided (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment intent was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | The customer's first name. |
| `data.customer_first_name` | `string` | The Customer Information card is First/Last name, not a display name — and a display name cannot be split back into them. |
| `data.customer_last_name` | `string` | The customer's last name. |
| `data.customer_email` | `string` | The customer's email. |
| `data.customer_phone` | `string` | The customer's phone number. |
| `data.gateway_key` | `string` | The gateway that processes the payment. |
| `data.gateway_account` | `string` | A business can hold several accounts on one gateway (“Stripe / Stripe-1”), so the key alone names nothing. |
| `data.gateway_account_label` | `string` | The label of the gateway account. |
| `data.payment_method_brand` | `string` | The card brand used. |
| `data.payment_method_last4` | `string` | The last four digits of the card used. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |

|---|---|

| `400` | Unknown query parameter, status, purpose or limit |
| `404` | No such business |
